title: Quant profile override and validation run for RegModel (customer-requested)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Customer (FinReg Inc.) has requested a temporary override of the automatic quantization profile selection for their RegModel-XL deployed under a Redwood Private instance. They report an accuracy regression after switching to our new FP8 profile in a recent rollout. Customer is requesting a controlled, customer-specific profile (override) and a validation run on their production-like holdout to ensure restored parity with their certified accuracy thresholds. This ticket covers the creation of a customer-scoped quant profile, running the calibration/validation pipeline against a stratified seed set, and producing a signed report that the customer can use for their audit. Scope excludes changes to global default profiles or long-term product policy — this is a targeted, reversible support action.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Customer-scoped quant profile (FP8 and INT8 variants) is produced and stored under customer namespace.
2) Calibration run completes on customer's provided holdout (approx 5k examples) with logs uploaded.
3) Accuracy delta (task-level metric) <= 1.0 percentage point vs baseline on the holdout; embedding cosine similarity delta <= 0.02 for semantic tasks.
4) Detailed layer-wise error and per-token distribution artifacts available in shared drive; report uploaded to Confluence.
5) Rollback plan validated and smoke-tested on a canary.
6) Customer sign-off captured in thread.
run_plan:
- Stage: snapshot customer's model version from private deployment; verify checksums.
- Generate two candidate custom profiles: profile-A (FP8 signature-preserving mapping) and profile-B (INT8 hybrid with per-layer scale override).
- Calibration: run 3 calibration seeds across stratified holdout (small -> full) and capture per-layer quantization delta metrics.
- Validation: run full eval harness (classification accuracy, regression RMSE where relevant, embedding cosine similarity, hallucination-check prompts) and compare to baseline.
- Observability: enable token-level traces for the run, dump KV-cache histograms and activation range summaries.
- Deliverable: signed validation report, artifacts links, and PR with changes to customer profile only (no global profile edits).
risk_notes:
- FP8 can expose distributional sensitivity on rare tokens; must monitor layer outliers and runtime NaNs.
- Customer's prod data has legal/regulatory constraints: do not exfiltrate raw PII. All artifacts must be sanitized.
- If both profiles fail acceptance, fallback to model pinned to pre-rollout quant variant and initiate cross-team incident review.
comments: 2026-02-24 Maya Chen: Ticket opened after FinReg support escalation. Customer provided three anonymized datasets and their internal baseline metrics. They included a CSV of failing prompts and expected tags. Assigned to Luca.

2026-02-26 Luca Moreno: Reproduced reported delta on local replica; preliminary signals point to a single attention layer with widened activation range after recent kernel change. Collected activation snapshots and uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood.ai/finreg/eng/ENG-24109/activations.zip

2026-03-01 Luca Moreno: Ran two smoke profiles (A/B) on 500-ex sample. FP8-profile-A shows smaller latency improvement but preserves accuracy; INT8-profile-B reduced model size more but dropped exact-match on regulatory classification by ~2.5pp. Need to run full 5k holdout to be certain. Created feature branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4621

2026-03-05 Support (Aisha Patel): Customer provided additional labeled examples for edge-case category 'currency-normalization'. Added to stratified holdout. Also requested timeboxed SLA of 48 hrs for the validation report.

2026-03-08 ML QA (Diego Ramos): Full calibration run (3 seeds) completed on the 5k holdout. Attached evaluation dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/eng/ENG-24109/eval. FP8-profile-A: accuracy delta +0.6pp, embedding delta 0.015 - within thresholds. INT8-profile-B: accuracy delta +1.8pp, fails threshold. Recommend rolling FP8-profile-A for customer override with monitoring.

2026-03-10 Luca Moreno: Prepared signed validation report and rollback playbook. Created customer-scoped profile in config store under namespace finreg/overrides/2026-03-10/profile-A.json. Initiating canary deployment to customer's dedicated slice at 10% traffic tomorrow AM. Notifying SRE and Customer Success for coordination.
next_steps:

2) Observe latency and error budgets for 6 hours; collect traces.
